## Feature Summary

A clear and concise description of the feature or epic you would like to see.

## Motivation / Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it valuable?

## Proposed Solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives Considered

Other solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## Priority

Indicate priority keywords if applicable: critical / urgent / high / medium / low.

## Additional Context

Add screenshots, mockups, or any other context about the feature request.
